title: Rank Branded Foods by one nutrient (April 2026)
purpose: Rank the Branded Foods in this FoodData Central release by their amount per 100 g as USDA calculates it from the label of one nutrient, highest or lowest first, with each food's FDC id, description, brand owner, brand name, the nutrient's name and unit and the amount. Foods without a published amount for the nutrient are left out. Ties order by description, then FDC id. Each food and nutrient pair has one amount in this release.

parameters.name: nutrient_id
parameters.description: Nutrient id in this release (fdc-branded-food-nutrients-2026-04 lists them, for example 1003 protein or 1162 vitamin C)

output_columns.name: fdc_id
output_columns.description: FoodData Central id of the food

output_columns.name: brand_name
output_columns.description: Brand name as published, where given

output_columns.name: amount
output_columns.description: Amount per 100 g as USDA calculates it from the label of the food, as published
